name: Hummus
siboNotes: Contains galactans from chickpeas and potentially garlic. Start with small portions and monitor tolerance during SIBO treatment phases.
preparationTips: Look for garlic-free versions or make at home without garlic
Start with 1-2 tablespoons to test tolerance
Some brands use garlic powder vs fresh garlic which may be better tolerated
Homemade allows control over ingredients and FODMAP content
nutritionalHighlights: healthy fats from tahini and olive oil
